com.delta.airplayreceiver.title: AirCast: AirPlay Phone to TV
com.delta.airplayreceiver.description:
Turn your Android TV into a powerful screen mirroring receiver with AirCast.

AirCast allows you to mirror iPhone to Android TV and cast videos, photos, music, and games wirelessly from your iOS devices. This easy-to-use screen mirroring and TV casting app supports AirPlay-compatible streaming, allowing you to display your iPhone or iPad screen on a larger TV without cables.

Whether you're watching videos, sharing photos, or presenting content, AirCast makes casting from iPhone to TV simple and reliable. 

Features
📱 Mirror iPhone to Android TV
Enjoy stable screen mirroring from iPhone to Android TV with smooth playback and high-definition display.
🎬 Cast Videos, Photos & Music
Easily cast videos, photos, and music from iPhone to TV for a better viewing and listening experience.
